title: Why Is the K in Knight Silent?
description:
Knight, knife, knee, know: they all start with a letter nobody says. A thousand years ago English speakers pronounced that K. Here is how the sound disappeared and why the spelling never changed. English and Arabic subtitles.

00:14 How It Sounded
